content.body: Pardon the merge request dance, for those who have been following.
It was brought to my attention that the repo where we work on the standard should not have any tooling committed to it.
So I've just submitted a MR that just updates the .md file

If you'd like to take the tooling that produced it (and can round trip to docx), that's on my fork: https://forge.etsi.org/rep/whalleya/en-304-617/-/tree/main_publish/tools/etsi-cra-md-docx?ref_type=heads
I'll find somewhere better for it to go at some point.
